title: Why did your team cancel {product}? 4 minutes to help us fix it
description: A short exit survey for the admin who cancelled their team's {product} subscription in the last 30 days.
audience: The account admin who cancelled their team's {product} subscription in the last 30 days
purpose: Decide which of five churn drivers (price for value, missing features, ease of use, reliability, support) to fix first

welcome.title: Help us understand why you cancelled

thank_you.title: Thank you, that really helps
thank_you.description: We review every answer at the end of each month and publish what we changed in our product update. If you agreed to a call, we'll email you within a week to find a time. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: Did you cancel your team's {product} subscription in the last 30 days?
What was the main reason your team cancelled?
questions.description: Pick the one that mattered most.
options: The price was too high for the value
It was too hard for the team to learn and use
Our needs changed (budget, team or project)

questions.label: What happened that made this the main reason?
questions.description: A sentence or two is plenty.

questions.label: Overall, how satisfied or dissatisfied was your team with {product} before you cancelled?
Next: how much each factor mattered
How much did each of these contribute to your decision to cancel?
What is your team using instead of {product} now?
options: Another product built for the same job

questions.label: Almost done: two quick questions about your team
How many people on your team used {product}?
questions.description: So we can see whether reasons differ by team size.

questions.label: Would you be open to a 15-minute call with our product team?
Which email address can we use to arrange the call?
questions.description: We'll use it only to schedule this one call.
